posts.content: 今天班主任杨景然似乎发疯了，一直在惩罚人，不知道想干啥。小区里有住户的玻璃被神秘物体击碎，已经立案调查。不过说来，我周末好像往楼下扔了几个泡泡珠，就是那种原来很小的珠子泡水变大的那种。但按照它的重量及我家四楼的高度来算，应该不会把玻璃击碎。更何况我也没有听见玻璃被击碎的声音，应该不是我做的吧……
posts.content_en: Today, Teacher Yang Jingran, our head teacher, seems to have lost her mind. She kept punishing students, and I have no idea what she was trying to do. A resident in the community had their window glass shattered by an unknown object, and the case has been filed for investigation. Come to think of it, I dropped a few water beads downstairs over the weekend — those tiny beads that swell up when soaked in water. But judging by their weight and the fact that I live on the fourth floor, they shouldn’t be heavy enough to break glass. What’s more, I didn’t hear any glass shattering at all. It probably wasn’t me, right…
